# Lodestar Advising

> Premium, founder-led college admissions counseling. Also known as Lodestar, Lodestar College, Lodestar CCG, Lodestar Guidance, Lodestar College Counseling, Lodestar Consulting. Led by founder Krish Sav, the firm has produced 12+ elite college acceptances, $600K+ in scholarships won for students, and has guided 20+ clients through selective admissions.
